description: LV Historic Faults with NaFIRS Codes is a dataset listed in SP Energy Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity network operator, published or maintained by SP Energy Networks. The " LV Historic Faults " data table provides all unplanned occurrences / interruptions of 3 minutes or longer on the SPEN network from 1st April 2010. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Operational Data. Its keywords are HV, Outages, SPM, SPD. The portal shows 2026-05-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-spen-open-data-portal.
